Fonts installed on this computer

Source: R/fonts.R
available_fonts.Rd

Lists the font families installed on this computer, using the systemfonts package. These are the fonts a figure can use when it is drawn here: in static images (save_image(), knitted documents) and in figures viewed in a browser on this computer.

Usage

available_fonts()

Value

A sorted character vector of font family names.

Details

A figure's fonts are set with family properties (e.g. update_layout(font = go_font(family = "Georgia"))), which take a CSS font list such as "Inter, Arial, sans-serif": the browser drawing the figure uses the first family in the list that it has, or a generic family (serif, sans-serif, monospace) at the end.

Interactive figures are drawn in each viewer's browser, so they use the fonts installed on the viewer's computer, which R can't see (and browsers don't let pages list them): a font installed here may be missing for someone opening the HTML file or Shiny app elsewhere. Lists that end with widely available fonts and a generic family ("Inter, Arial, sans-serif") look reasonable everywhere.

save_image() warns when the first family of a figure's font list is not installed here.

See also

go_font()

Examples

head(available_fonts())
#> [1] "C059"                 "D050000L"             "DejaVu Math TeX Gyre"
#> [4] "DejaVu Sans"          "DejaVu Sans Mono"     "DejaVu Serif"        
"Arial" %in% available_fonts()
#> [1] FALSE
